A subject, followed along the whole path

Nothing gets lost

On the phone first, kept as you go, safe in an account or a backup.

Start Before the first record

What it is

These promises are written on Home under What to expect, and they are what the app does today:

  • Free. No ads and nothing to buy.
  • Your records stay on your phone unless you choose to keep them in an account as well.
  • You can take everything out: CSV for Excel or Google Sheets, JSON, Artisan and Cropster files for roasts, the EU plot file and Google Earth for plots.
  • Every tip names its source: a study, the Coffee Board, or common practice.
  • It works with no signal.
  • The app and its code belong to KoffyKraft; your records belong to you.

Step 5 · Sign in with my email

To sign in: on the Account page, find Private cloud account and type your email in the Email box. There is no password; each time, Roast emails you a 6-digit code.

Seen fromOn your phone, step 5Getting set up

What it is · Work where there is no signal

Roast is built for hill farms, drying yards and store rooms where the signal comes and goes.

  • Everything is saved on the phone first. Origin shows Saved on this device; a saved record shows On this phone.
  • Find works with no signal. It searches the records on this phone.
  • The ? still works. With a signal it opens the full guide on koffykraft.coffee; without one, the guide kept inside the app.
  • New versions arrive by themselves. Check for updates on Account looks now.

Seen fromOn your phone

Watch out

A few things ask a server and need the internet: signing in, the land check on a plot, and fetching weather. The app says so when it needs a connection; nothing you typed is lost.

Seen fromOn your phoneGuidance, not guarantee

Watch out · Keep a backup of my records

Without an account, records live only in this phone's browser. Clearing the browser's data, or removing the app, removes them too. When a backup is due, Now shows a Keep a copy card: after 14 days when records are only on this phone, after 30 when signed in. Backup reminder on Account changes this to weekly, after each save, or off.

Seen fromOn your phone

Why it matters

Working on the phone first means a bad signal never stops a harvest being written down. An account or a backup file means a lost phone never takes a season with it.

Plot Where it grows

Watch out

The land check needs a signal and a signed-in account, and the app says so if either is missing. It is guidance for getting ready, not a certificate. If you change the outline later, the plot says the check describes the earlier shape, and offers Check again.

Tip

With no signal the satellite picture cannot load, but points, outlines and the scale still work; the map says so. Your marks are kept on the phone.

Step 10 · Walk and record a trail

Open Trails and tap ● Start a trail. Allow location, pick what the trail is (a path, a road, a drain, a boundary, the rows of plants), and walk. Add a photo or a stop with a note on the way. Finish when you are done: distance, time and climb show.

Try it in the app ›

Seen fromEstates and plots, step 10One coffee, one chain

Watch out

Keep the screen on and the page open while you walk: phones stop giving the location to a web page when the screen goes off. Trails stay on this phone only, not in your account, so save a backup from the Trails list now and then.

Seen fromEstates and plots

Step 13 · Log fertiliser, water and work

Open Field log (an account is needed). Pick the tab: Nutrients, Water, Plant health or Work done, then ＋ New entry. Choose the place and date and fill what you know. For fertiliser, the grade gives the nutrients per hectare.

What it is

Field log and Weather, like Team, Jobs, Sales and money, and Land and dues, keep their records in your account, so every phone you sign in on sees the same list. Entries made with no signal wait on the phone and are sent when it is back online; Team, Jobs and Land and dues mark them waiting to send until then.

Step 6 · Time a step

When a step begins, tap Start now: it shows Running with a clock. When it is over, tap End now. Still running opens it again if you ended it by mistake.

Business People, work, sales, land

What it is

These pages keep their records in your account, so every phone you sign in on sees the same list. Without an account they ask you to sign in. Entries made with no signal wait on the phone and are sent when it is back online.

Your records Copies, exports, leaving

What it is

Everything you enter is saved on this phone first. With an account, you choose what also goes to your private cloud: section by section, nothing, only what you pick, or everything. Removing something from the cloud never deletes it from this phone.

Seen fromYour recordsRecords you can trust

Step 1 · Choose what goes to the cloud

Signed in, open Account. Under Cloud sync, each section (Origin, Roasts, Cup) has Off, Selected and All. Off keeps it on this phone. Selected sends only the records you tap Save to cloud on. All sends every record you save. Each section shows how many records are in the cloud.

Seen fromYour records, step 1Getting set up

Step 2 · Save a copy of everything

Open My data (from Account, or from the person button). Tap Export everything for one file with all your records. Save / Share archive sends it through the phone's share sheet to Files, Drive, Dropbox or a computer.

Try it in the app ›

Seen fromYour records, step 2

Step 3 · Bring my records back on a new phone

On the new phone, open My data and tap Import, then pick the file you saved.

Seen fromYour records, step 3

Step 4 · Set how often I am reminded to back up

On Account, Backup reminder sets how often Now reminds you: every few weeks (standard), weekly, after each save, or off.

Seen fromYour records, step 4

Step 5 · Export a list for a spreadsheet

Most lists have Export for CSV (Excel or Google Sheets) or JSON: Origin, Cup, the Roastbook and the Map. Roasts also go out as Artisan and Cropster files, plots as GeoJSON and KML.

Seen fromYour records, step 5Records you can trust

Step 8 · Remove my records from this phone

On My data, export first, then Delete local KoffyKraft data removes them from this phone.

Seen fromYour records, step 8

Step 9 · Delete my account

On Account, open Delete my account. Save a backup file first. Choose the Wait before deleting (24 hours, 3 days, 7 days or 30 days) and tap Email me a deletion code. Entering the code deletes your account and all your cloud records after the wait; you can cancel until then. What is on this phone stays until you clear it.

Seen fromYour records, step 9Records you can trust

What it is

The privacy notice says what is kept, for how long, and what happens to your records if KoffyKraft closes. You agree to it when you first sign in.

Help Snags and words

What it is

No signal. Keep working: everything you enter is saved on the phone first. Pages that keep records in your account (Field log, Weather, Team, Jobs, Sales and money, Land and dues) send what you entered when the phone is back online. Only signing in, the land check and fetching weather need the signal at that moment, and the app says so.

Seen fromWhen something goes wrong, and the words used

What it is

I changed phones or cleared the browser. Sign in with the same email and the records you kept in the cloud come back. Records that were only on the old phone come back from a backup file through My data, Import. Trails live only on the phone where they were walked, so keep their backup file.
